scope: Investigation only; no production HTML policy change. Native outputs, not Kitty/Neovim UI acceptance.

method.fixtures: Source stored verbatim per case; cmark-gfm --to xml --sourcepos; production --html plain/marked/plain alerts and LOAD; isolated rejection-only bypass LOAD/DRAW; plain stock render versus bypass marked via ImageMagick AE at both widths.
method.bypass: Exactly the two Raw HTML rejection throws in src/preview.cpp replaced with (void)0 in an isolated copy. Existing compile/link commands and adapter objects reused. No raw-block labeling or sanitization added. Not a support implementation.
method.mapping: Following heading FRAG floor(y) compared to actual DRAW top. Pixel parity is independent plain vs marked rendering; not an independent text-leaf/draw coordinate oracle.
method.recovery: One production native worker: valid LOAD/DRAW rev1, raw HTML LOAD/DRAW rev2, corrected escaped HTML LOAD/DRAW rev3, QUIT. Files unchanged; Neovim buffer/controller not exercised here.
method.limits: Small synthetic fixtures at 360/700px, fixed 800px raster; no arbitrary HTML, terminal visual, performance or resource-bound claims. Sup/sub combined fixture; comments and malformed tags included.
method.storage: Successful --html output retains body and full-output SHA256; shared stylesheet/wrapper omitted to avoid duplication. Protocol stdout/stderr retained verbatim.
